name: DTR run outcomes
query: WITH runs AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (payload->>'run_id') payload,event_time,received_at FROM events WHERE event_type_id='e0ba0d5d-bc36-46a9-855e-dcb3697e5ca8' AND payload->>'demo_site'='dertour' AND payload->>'synthetic'='true' ORDER BY payload->>'run_id',event_time DESC, received_at DESC) SELECT payload->>'run_id' AS run_id,payload->>'persona' AS persona,payload->>'experiment' AS experiment,payload->>'stage' AS stage,payload->>'destination' AS destination, COALESCE((payload->>'searched')::numeric,0) AS searched,COALESCE((payload->>'checkout_started')::numeric,0) AS checkout_started,COALESCE((payload->>'confirmed')::numeric,0) AS confirmed,COALESCE((payload->>'net_booking')::numeric,0) AS net_booking,COALESCE((payload->>'repeat_booking')::numeric,0) AS repeat_booking,COALESCE((payload->>'net_value')::numeric,0) AS net_value,COALESCE((payload->>'ancillary_value')::numeric,0) AS ancillary_value,COALESCE((payload->>'ancillary_margin')::numeric,0) AS ancillary_margin, 1 AS eligible_run, CASE WHEN payload->>'stage'='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cancelled, CASE WHEN payload->>'complaint'='true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS service_case, CASE WHEN payload->>'stage' IN ('booked','completed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS acquisition_excluded, COALESCE((payload->>'net_value')::numeric,0)*0.12 + CASE WHEN payload->>'stage'='cancelled' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE((payload->>'ancillary_margin')::numeric,0) END AS illustrative_contribution, event_time AS updated_at FROM runs
